entries.name: box-constants-count-wraps-negative-accept#0
entries.description: A bare box whose size-flagged, segregated tree declares 2^32 - 1 constants (ff ff ff ff 0f) and has the body SigmaProp(true). deserializeConstants reads the count as getUInt().toInt and takes a negative count as no constants (ErgoTreeSerializer.scala:248-261), so the tree parses, and the JVM writes it back with count 0: NON-IDENTITY.

entries.name: box-constants-count-wraps-negative-unsized-accept#2
entries.description: A bare box whose unsized segregated tree (10) declares 2^32 - 1 constants. deserializeConstants reads the count as getUInt().toInt and takes a negative count as no constants (ErgoTreeSerializer.scala:248-261), so the tree parses, and the JVM writes it back with count 0: NON-IDENTITY.

entries.name: box-bool-collection-count-2-32-accept#3
entries.description: A bare box whose tree is BoolToSigmaProp(EQ(SizeOf(<85, count 2^32>), 0)): a Boolean collection constant whose count VLQ is 2^32. scorex-util 0.2.0's getUShort is getULong().toInt followed by the 0..65535 check, so the 32-bit truncation comes first: a count of 2^32 + k reads as k. The tree parses and comes back with the count written as k: NON-IDENTITY. An impl that range-checks the full value rejects it: the over-reject. Here k = 0: an empty collection, written back as 85 00.

entries.name: box-bool-collection-count-2-32-plus-1-accept#4
entries.description: A bare box whose tree is BoolToSigmaProp(EQ(SizeOf(<85, count 2^32 + 1, bits 01>), 1)). scorex-util 0.2.0's getUShort is getULong().toInt followed by the 0..65535 check, so the 32-bit truncation comes first: a count of 2^32 + k reads as k. The tree parses and comes back with the count written as k: NON-IDENTITY. An impl that range-checks the full value rejects it: the over-reject. Here k = 1: one bit is read, written back as 85 01 01.

entries.name: box-collection-count-2-32-accept#5
entries.description: A bare box whose tree is BoolToSigmaProp(EQ(SizeOf(<83, count 2^32, Int>), 0)): a ConcreteCollection of Int (ConcreteCollectionSerializer.scala:28). scorex-util 0.2.0's getUShort is getULong().toInt followed by the 0..65535 check, so the 32-bit truncation comes first: a count of 2^32 + k reads as k. The tree parses and comes back with the count written as k: NON-IDENTITY. An impl that range-checks the full value rejects it: the over-reject. Written back as 83 00 04.
